drivingQuestion: On what principle do Rabbi and the Rabbis disagree about the minimum oil pledge?
outcomeNote: Rav Pappa's explanation falls to the baraita; he concedes

segments.he: אַמְרוּהָ רַבָּנַן קַמֵּיהּ דְּרַב פָּפָּא: בְּדוּן מִינַּהּ וּמִינַּהּ, בְּדוּן מִינַּהּ וְאוֹקֵים בְּאַתְרַהּ – קָא מִיפַּלְגִי.
segments.en: «The Sages said before Rav Pappa:» The Rabbis and Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi «disagree with regard to» the proper method of logical derivation when deriving the halakha with regard to one matter from the halakha with regard to another matter. One opinion holds that the proper method is to «infer from it, and» again «from it,» i.e., equate the two cases in all aspects, while the other holds that the comparison extends only to one specific issue derived from the primary case, in accordance with the principle: «Infer from it but interpret» the halakha according «to its» own «place,» i.e., in all other aspects the cases are not equated.

segments.he: רַבָּנַן סָבְרִי: דּוּן מִינַּהּ וּמִינַּהּ, מָה מִנְחָה מִתְנַדְּבִין – אַף שֶׁמֶן נָמֵי מִתְנַדְּבִין, וּמִינַּהּ: מָה מִנְחָה בְּלוֹג – אַף שֶׁמֶן בְּלוֹג.
segments.en: The Sages explained: «The Rabbis hold» by the principle: «Infer from it, and» again «from it.» The Gemara explains the application of this principle: «Just as a meal offering is contributed, so too oil is contributed,» as inferred from the verse addressing the meal offering. «And» again one infers «from» this source: «Just as a meal offering» requires «a log» of oil, «so too here,» an offering of oil alone must be «a log of oil.»

segments.he: וְרַבִּי סָבַר: דּוּן מִינַּהּ וְאוֹקֵי בְּאַתְרַהּ, מָה מִנְחָה מִתְנַדְּבִין, אַף שֶׁמֶן נָמֵי מִתְנַדְּבִין, וְאוֹקֵי בְּאַתְרַהּ כִּנְסָכִים, מָה נְסָכִים שְׁלֹשֶׁת לוּגִּין, אַף שֶׁמֶן נָמֵי שְׁלֹשֶׁת לוּגִּין.
segments.en: «And Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi «holds» that the proper method is to «infer from it but interpret» the halakha according «to its» own «place: Just as a meal offering is contributed, so too oil is contributed. But» with regard to all other aspects of this halakha, «interpret» the halakha according «to its» own «place,» and its status is «like» that of «libations,» which are similar to oil in that they are also poured onto the altar: «Just as» one contributes «libations» of «three log, so too» when one contributes «oil,» one contributes «three log.»

segments.he: אֲמַר לְהוּ רַב פָּפָּא: אִי מִמִּנְחָה גָּמַר לַהּ רַבִּי, דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא לָא פְּלִיגִי דּוּן מִינַּהּ וּמִינַּהּ, אֶלָּא רַבִּי מֵ״אֶזְרָח״ גְּמִיר לַהּ.
segments.en: «Rav Pappa said to» the Sages who suggested this interpretation: «If Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi «derived» the source of the gift offering of oil «from» the verse addressing the «meal offering,» he would not disagree with the Rabbis, «as everyone» employs the principle of: «Infer from it, and» again «from it. Rather, Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi «derives» the gift offering of oil «from» a verse concerning libations: “All that are «native born» shall do these things in this manner, in presenting an offering made by fire” (Numbers 15:13). Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi derives from here that just as one may contribute wine libations, so too one may contribute oil. Therefore, Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi compares oil to wine libations: Just as one contributes libations of three log, so too one contributes three log of oil.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב הוּנָא בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַב נָתָן לְרַב פָּפָּא: וּמִי מָצֵית אָמְרַתְּ הָכִי? וְהָתַנְיָא: ״קׇרְבָּן״ – מְלַמֵּד שֶׁמִּתְנַדְּבִין שֶׁמֶן, וְכַמָּה? שְׁלֹשֶׁת לוּגִּין. מַאן שָׁמְעַתְּ לֵיהּ דְּאָמַר שְׁלֹשֶׁת לוּגִּין? רַבִּי, וְקָא מַיְיתֵי לַהּ מִ״קׇּרְבָּן״. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: אִי תַּנְיָא תַּנְיָא.
segments.en: «Rav Huna, son of Rav Natan, said to Rav Pappa: And how can you say that» according to Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi the source of the gift offering of oil is not from the meal offering? «But isn’t it taught» in a baraita with regard to the verse: “And when one brings a meal offering «[korban minḥa]”» (Leviticus 2:1), that the superfluous word korban «teaches that one may contribute oil. And how much» must one contribute? «Three log.» The Gemara explains the question: «Who did you hear that says» the gift offering of oil is «three log? This is» the opinion of «Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi, «and» yet he «cites» the source of the gift offering of oil «from» the word «korban,» which is referring to a meal offering. Rav Pappa «said to him: If» this baraita «is taught, it is taught,» and I cannot take issue with it.
